Software: Strong, proven proficiency in QuickBooks (required) and strong Excel/Google Sheets skills. Attention to Detail: Exceptional precision and accuracy when working with numbers. Autonomy: Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to work independently with minimal supervision. Communication: Clear, professional written and verbal communication skills. Nice to Have Experience supporting an e-commerce business (specifically working with Shopify financial reporting).
